name: Yogic Levitation (Ki)
body:
The power of your mind allows you to defy gravity.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you can spend 1 point from your ki pool to levitate as the spell for as long as you maintain concentration, up to a maximum number of minutes equal to your Wisdom bonus. If you cease concentrating, you begin falling.

Alternatively, you can spend 1 point from your ki pool as an immediate action when you fall more than 10 feet, allowing you to feather fall for as long as you maintain concentration, up to a maximum number of rounds equal to your Wisdom bonus.

Special: Unlike the feather fall and levitate spells, Yogic Levitation only affects you, though you can carry other objects or creatures, subject to your maximum heavy load.
